items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Who was in Les Hite's Heidt's band then? ... Lionel Hampton. Marshall Royal.

ctx.x: Don't have too many of those anymore. You said you mentioned you went to Sebastian's Cotton Club while you were out here. Who was in Les Hite's Heidt's band then?
Lionel Hampton. Marshall Royal. Let's see, Lawrence Brown, and of course Louis Armstrong came in there, you know, and did all the recording with that
